content.title: 101 Happy Easter Wishes to Write in a Card or Send to Loved Ones
content.text: Let someone know you're thinking of them this Easter by sharing one of these heartfelt, cute or funny greetings.Updated April 3, 2026, 11:19 AM CDTSend a smile on April 5 using one of these inspirational, cute or funny Easter wishes.Anna Blazhuk / Getty ImagesCreate your free account or log in to save this articleEaster has arrived. However you plan to mark the occasion, whether it's gathering for an Easter brunch or attending service, you may want to remind friends and loved ones that you're thinking of them on the April holiday.If you're stuck on what to say or write in a card, see below to find a collection of Easter wishes to help inspire your words.Whether it's a relative, co-worker, neighbor, or someone else dear, these wishes are perfect for sending Easter greetings to everyone in your circle. Jot down one of these short, inspirational or religious sayings in a card, post one as an Instagram caption or forward via text to share glad Easter tidings.Looking for something heartfelt? Try “Wishing you an Easter filled with joy and a spring filled with peace and abundance” or “May your basket overflow with Easter cheer!”If you’re looking to keep things on the lighter side, you’ll find plenty of cute Easter wishes and Easter puns like: “Have an eggs-ceptional Easter” or “Don’t spend your Easter splitting hares.”Whatever sentiment you're looking for this year, you're sure to find it in collection of messages below. So, read on, and get ready to bring a smile to all your peeps on Easter Sunday.Happy Easter WishesMay hope and happiness be yours this Easter.Wishing you simple abundance and God's blessings today and every day.May the miracle of Easter bring you joy.Peace and happiness to you and yours this Easter Sunday.Sending the sweetest of thoughts for a happy Easter.Wishing you a glorious day this Easter.May God's goodness bless your home this Easter.Wishing you and yours Easter joy and a happy spring.He has risen on this day! Hallelujah!Wishing you love and gladness this Easter.Let there be spring! Happy Easter.Easter is in the air! Enjoy every moment.Sending you a dozen wishes for an eggs-cellent Easter. Here's hoping your Easter is bright and beautiful. Wherever you go, sunshine follows! Happy Easter.Spring has sprung! Sending you warm and colorful wishes for a bountiful day.Count me among those saying a prayer for you on Easter Sunday and every other day of the year.May grace and goodness fill your home this Easter.Grateful, thankful and blessed to celebrate you this Easter.Into every spring, a little Easter must fall.Wishing you an Easter filled with joy and a spring filled with peace and abundance.Cheerful wishes coming your way, for a bright and joyful Easter day!Rejoice in the spirit of faith and family. Happy Easter.Cute Easter WishesHope your Easter is eggs-tra special this year.Happy Easter. Happy spring. Happy everything!Here to say, have a happy Easter day!Let the season of sun warm your doorstep this Easter.May your basket overflow with Easter cheer!Keep calm and color Easter eggs.Wishing you and yours an eggs-ceptional Easter.May the warmth of the spring sun shine on your Easter.Chocolate bunnies are good, but friends are forever.Wishing you the joy of Easter all year long.Sending Easter wishes eggs-specially to you!I'm just hopping by to wish you a happy Easter.Happy Easter to every bunny!Here's hoping your Easter is eggs-cellent.Hoping your Easter is as special as you are. Happy Easter Wishes for Friends and FamilyMay the joys of Easter fill your heart with gladness.Wishing you and yours peace this Easter season.Sending Easter blessings today and every day.May peace and love be in abundance this Easter Sunday.Happy Easter to a good egg.A little peep told me that Easter’s on its way.Have an Easter-ific holiday.Hoppy Easter! Bunny kisses and Easter wishes for a day that’s truly eggs-cellent.Wishing you all the delights of a Sunday morning brunch this Easter.May the sun be shining, the jelly beans plentiful and the eggs easy to find. Sending warm fuzzies this Easter and a reminder that some bunny loves you!Here’s wishing you a bright Easter and a magical start to the spring season.Sending Easter wishes and greetings to let you know that I carrot a whole lot. May you be inspired by the joy, hope and renewal found in this beautiful season.Hoping your Easter celebration is sweeter than a marshmallow Peep and brighter than the spring sunshine.I wish you a day filled with whatever makes you smile and fills you with the hope of the Easter season. And chocolate, of course.In this house, every bunny is welcome on Easter. May spring flowers and colored eggs fill your season with joy.Hippity hoppity, Easter's on its way! Blossoms abound when springtime's around, bringing loved ones so dear to celebrate that Easter is here.Wishing you plenty of painted eggs, chocolate bunnies and all things pretty this Easter.Celebrate and rejoice in the spirit of spring.Easter greetings to those we love and wishes for a joyous day filled with blessings from above.Sweet dreams and jelly beans this fine Easter day.Hope you get eggs-actly what you want for Easter.Sending wishes for a 14-carrot Easter.Happy Easter to all my favorite peeps!Hope your Easter is a hop, skip and a jump.Funny Easter Wishes Just so you know, your Easter eggs are hard to beat.It’s do or dye. Happy Easter.Thumb-bunny loves you.Chick out my Easter basket. It’s egg-cellent.Are you an Easter basket? Because you look sweet.They said I could be anything I want. So, I picked the Easter Bunny.My Easter eggs are better than yours and I’m dyeing to prove it.Easter: Trying to remember where you hid something 12 hours ago.The only rabbit that shows up at my house on Easter is a dust bunny.Hope the Easter Bunny brings you a little peeps and quiet this year.It's Easter. Let your hare down.It’s Easter for peep’s sake!Hope this year's Easter eggs are to dye for.Have an eggs-ceptional Easter.Here's hoping your Easter ends the way it's supposed to. With an "r."Speak now or forever hold your peeps.I can't contain my egg-citement. Happy Easter!My side dish this Easter is wine ... for one.Don't worry, be hoppy.Looking for the Easter Bunny? I haven't seen nor hare of him.Don't spend your Easter splitting hares.Making fun of my Easter eggs? Omelette that slide this time.Stay calm and tell me where the Easter eggs are.All I'm sayin' is give peeps a chance.Religious Easter WishesHe is risen! Wishing you a delightful Easter filled with hope, joy and the wonder of God’s blessings.Honoring the sacrifice made His name and salvation on this blessed day.May God bless you with faith and family this Easter.Rejoice in the resurrection of the Lord, our savior."This is the day the Lord has made, let us rejoice and be glad in it." Psalm 118:24My the light of the Lord fill your soul with joy today and every day."Mercy, peace and love be yours in abundance." — Jude 1:2Deep peace of the earth to you and yours this Easter Day.The miracle of the season gives us reason to celebrate Easter.May God's love surround you and your loved ones this Easter.
